title: Content Moderation — Use Scores to Route Cases
key_insight: High-confidence safe cases can pass, uncertain cases can reach review, and severe high-confidence cases can block.
body:
## Use Scores to Route Cases

A classifier returns likelihoods, not courtroom certainty. Different categories and actions need different thresholds.

High-confidence safe cases can pass, uncertain cases can reach review, and severe high-confidence cases can block.

Calibrate on representative languages and formats. Measure both harmful misses and legitimate content wrongly restricted.
common_mistakes: A classifier removes the need for written policy.
Uncertain cases should always be treated as definitely harmful.
Reviewer safety has no effect on moderation quality.
mini_exercise: Draw “Use Scores to Route Cases” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Moderation applies explicit policy to user and model content with calibrated automation and human escalation.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Use Scores to Route Cases” to explain Content Moderation plainly.
